A set's bytes are verified against the LAST identity in its identity_history; a protected set (candidate, frozen) gains a new identity only by appending an entry that cites a maintainer authorization. New evaluation needs are added as new sets (eval-set-2, ...), never by rewriting an old one. AUTHORIZES NOTHING.
